--- a/policy/policy.md
+++ b/policy/policy.md
@@ -108,6 +108,8 @@
 
 Change flights: 
-- Basic economy flights cannot be modified.
-- Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
+- "Basic economy flights cannot be modified" means ONLY that the flight SEGMENTS (the flight numbers, dates, or route) of a basic economy reservation cannot be changed. It does NOT freeze the whole reservation. A basic economy reservation can STILL: change its cabin class (see "Change cabin"), update passenger details (see "Change passengers"), and add baggage (see "Change baggage"). Do NOT refuse those requests, and do NOT cancel the reservation as a stand-in for a change you are actually allowed to make.
+  - Worked example (ALLOWED): a user's only reservation is basic economy and they ask to "upgrade to economy, change the passenger to me, and add three bags." All three are allowed — the flights stay the same. Call update_reservation_flights with the SAME flights and cabin='economy', then update_reservation_passengers (same passenger count), then update_reservation_baggages. Refusing here is WRONG.
+  - Worked example (NOT allowed): a user with a basic economy reservation asks to move to a DIFFERENT flight or a different date. That is a flight-segment change and is not allowed on basic economy. Explain this, and if the user wants, offer to cancel the reservation (only if it is eligible for cancellation) and rebook. If the user is prepared to cancel, proceed to cancel per the "Cancel flight" rules.
+- Other (non-basic-economy) reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
 - Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price.
 - The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!
@@ -117,6 +119,8 @@
 - In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.
 - Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.
-- If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference.
-- If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.
+- One cabin applies to EVERY passenger on the reservation. You cannot upgrade or downgrade only some passengers. If a full-reservation cabin change does not fit the user's stated budget, you cannot substitute a partial (single-passenger) upgrade — in that case do NOT change the cabin at all, and tell the user it does not fit their budget.
+- The cost of a cabin change is the per-passenger price difference MULTIPLIED BY the number of passengers on the reservation — a common mistake is to forget the number of passengers. Before you confirm any cabin/flight change, call get_reservation_flights_update_price to get the exact `amount_due` (it already multiplies by the number of passengers and uses live prices), and STATE that exact figure to the user (e.g. "Upgrading both passengers to business will cost $1,200.").
+- If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference (the positive `amount_due`).
+- If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price (a downgrade), the user should be refunded the difference. This refund is ONLY the fare DIFFERENCE (what they paid minus the new lower total) — NOT the full original fare. When a user asks to move to a cheaper/lower cabin, perform the downgrade with update_reservation_flights keeping the same flights; the reservation stays active (do NOT cancel it to give a "full refund"), and clearly state the exact difference-refund amount (the absolute value of the negative `amount_due`).
 
 Change baggage and insurance: 
@@ -130,4 +134,5 @@
 Payment: 
 - If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.
+- Use the EXACT payment method the user names for this change. If the user identifies a card by its last four digits (e.g. "charge the difference to my card ending in 7334"), find the matching card in their profile — get_user_details lists each card's `last_four` — and pass THAT card's `payment_id`. Do NOT default to the card already on the reservation when the user has specified a different one.
